warnings: This is a first reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) for an unpaid invoice; it adds a 3,00 EUR 'Erinnerungspauschale'. Under German law a reminder fee is only owed once the debtor is already in default (Verzug, section 286 BGB) - a prior fixed due date or a previous dunning notice is usually required. Since no earlier invoice due date is shown and this appears to be the first reminder, the 3,00 EUR fee may not be legally owed; the recipient may want to check whether an earlier invoice with a due date was actually sent before paying this surcharge.

The sender's postal code (35582 Musterwettenberg) suggests Hesse rather than Nordrhein-Westfalen; this did not affect the due-date calculation since the deadline is an explicit calendar date, but it is worth noting the mismatch with the stated region.
